name: gke-ai-troubleshooting-handle-disruption-gpu-tpu
description: >- Diagnoses, predicts, and mitigates node disruptions during Compute Engine host maintenance and hardware or software maintenance events for GPU and TPU workloads on GKE. Use when diagnosing node disruptions, predicting host maintenance events on GPU/TPU nodepools, inspecting node interruption PromQL metrics, auditing node taints, or configuring workload protection strategies (graceful termination, opportunistic maintenance, PodDisruptionBudgets). Don't use for general GKE cluster creation, net
author: google
summary_zh: 用于诊断、预测并缓解 GKE 中 GPU/TPU 节点维护中断，适合排查中断指标、审计污点及配置工作负载保护策略。
